# Valid Skill — Fixture Style Guide

This dummy style guide exists only so that the reference
`references/style-guide.md` inside the `valid-skill` fixture resolves on disk.

Rules encoded by this fixture:

- The frontmatter `name` must equal the parent directory name.
- The `description` must be 1-1024 characters of real prose.
- Every relative reference mentioned in SKILL.md must resolve to a file.
- Text files must contain no placeholder markers.
